blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano triathlon standouts Andrew Kim Remolino and Raven Faith Alcoseba will banner the Philippine team competing in the 2026 Asia Triathlon Cup Chongqing in China. The Philippine delegation leaves for China on Wednesday, October 28, led by national coach Ani De Leon Brown and composed of athletes Dayshaun Ramos, Remolino, and Aki Lorbes. Alcoseba, who has been training in China, will join the team there. Remolino heads to Chongqing following a string of international competitions, including the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, last September, where he teamed up with fellow Cebuano Alcoseba in the mixed relay, which […]...
